def max_captures(s: str) -> int:
    n = len(s)
    best = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        if s[i] != '.':
            continue
        
        # simulate placing W at i
        board = list(s)
        board[i] = 'W'
        
        # Check that no white group gets surrounded by black stones
        # We check the white group containing i
        l = r = i
        while l > 0 and board[l-1] == 'W':
            l -= 1
        while r < n-1 and board[r+1] == 'W':
            r += 1
        
        left_edge = (l == 0) or (board[l-1] == 'B')
        right_edge = (r == n-1) or (board[r+1] == 'B')
        
        if left_edge and right_edge:
            # This white group would be captured — illegal move
            continue
        
        # Count black stones captured by placing W at i
        captured = 0
        # Check left side
        if i > 0 and board[i-1] == 'B':
            # find contiguous black group to the left
            j = i-1
            while j >= 0 and board[j] == 'B':
                j -= 1
            # captured if left side is edge or white
            if j < 0 or board[j] == 'W':
                captured += (i-1 - j)
        # Check right side
        if i < n-1 and board[i+1] == 'B':
            j = i+1
            while j < n and board[j] == 'B':
                j += 1
            if j == n or board[j] == 'W':
                captured += (j - (i+1))
        
        best = max(best, captured)
    
    return best
